user.title: Sign in to Apple
user.description: HA-FindMy uses local Anisette. No external Anisette server is required.

two_factor_method.title: Two-factor authentication
two_factor_method.description: Choose where Apple should send the verification code.

two_factor_code.title: Verification code
two_factor_code.description: Enter the code sent by Apple.

recovery_device.title: Choose a trusted device
recovery_device.description: Choose the device whose screen-lock passcode will be used to read the Find My accessory keys from iCloud Keychain.

device_passcode.title: Device screen-lock passcode
device_passcode.description: Enter the PIN/password used to unlock the selected Apple device. It is used only for this recovery request and is not stored.

accessories.title: Choose Find My accessories
accessories.description: Select the accessories to add to Home Assistant.

error.invalid_auth: Apple rejected the Apple ID or password.
error.unexpected_state: Apple returned an unexpected authentication state.
error.cannot_request_code: Could not request a verification code.
error.invalid_passcode: The keychain recovery request was rejected. Check the device passcode.
error.cannot_recover: Could not recover Find My accessory keys.

abort.already_configured: This Apple ID is already configured.
abort.cannot_get_2fa: Could not enumerate two-factor authentication methods.
abort.cannot_open_keychain: Signed in, but iCloud Keychain recovery could not be opened.
abort.no_recovery_devices: No usable iCloud Keychain recovery devices were returned for this account.
abort.no_accessories: No locatable Find My accessories were found.

recovery_device.title: Choose a trusted device
recovery_device.description: To refresh the accessory list, choose the device whose screen-lock passcode can unlock the Find My keys in iCloud Keychain.

device_passcode.title: Device screen-lock passcode
device_passcode.description: Enter the PIN/password used to unlock the selected Apple device. It is used only for this recovery request and is not stored.

accessories.title: Manage Find My accessories
accessories.description: Select the accessories that should be available in Home Assistant. Deselect an accessory to remove its entities and device.

reauth.title: Reauthenticate with Apple
reauth.description: To refresh Find My accessories for {email}, Apple requires a fresh password-equivalent token. Enter your Apple ID password. The password is used only for this operation and is not stored.

two_factor_method.title: Two-factor authentication
two_factor_method.description: Choose where Apple should send the verification code.

two_factor_code.title: Verification code
two_factor_code.description: Enter the code sent by Apple.

error.invalid_passcode: The keychain recovery request was rejected. Check the device passcode.
error.cannot_recover: Could not recover Find My accessory keys.
error.invalid_auth: Apple rejected the Apple ID or password.
error.unexpected_state: Apple returned an unexpected authentication state.
error.cannot_request_code: Could not request a verification code.
error.recovery_failed: Apple rejected the escrow recovery. This can mean the selected device passcode is wrong, but Apple returns the same failure for some escrow-protocol mismatches. Verify the passcode or try a different trusted device.
error.keychain_recovery_failed: The selected recovery record could not provide usable iCloud Keychain material. Try a different trusted Apple device if one is available.
error.accessory_discovery_failed: The device passcode recovery completed, but Find My accessories could not be decrypted/read from iCloud.

abort.cannot_open_keychain: Apple authentication succeeded, but iCloud Keychain recovery could not be opened.
abort.no_recovery_devices: No usable iCloud Keychain recovery devices were returned for this account.
abort.no_accessories: No locatable Find My accessories were found.
abort.cannot_get_2fa: Could not enumerate two-factor authentication methods.
